description.availability_grid:
Input the number of group members then select the day you plan on entering.

For keyboard users, use the Shift/Tab keys to navigate the table and the space bar to select a start date, as well as an end date if you plan on staying more than one day.
description.cancellation_policy:
Cancellation Policy:

  • Once a reservation is made the reservation fee in non-refundable.
  • Once a permit is issued there will be no refunds.
  • The permit is non-transferable.
  • No rain checks or credits.

Change Policy:

  • If you need to change your dates, you will need to cancel your existing reservation and make a new one; all fees will be forfeited and do not transfer to new reservation.
  • The permit is non-transferable. 
  • Group size cannot be changed. If you wish to increase group size a new reservation with additional persons must be made.
description.description: An enchanting landscape awaits you in southwestern Oklahoma on the Wichita Mountains Wildlife Refuge. Located within the more than 59,000 acres that make up the Wichita Mountains Wildlife Refuge, the Charon’s Garden Wilderness Area offers a unique back-country camping experience. The Charon's Garden Wilderness area consists of a rocky, rugged landscape, with areas featuring huge granite boulders, scattered around on the granite surface. In addition to enchanting landscapes the Charon's Garden Wilderness Area offers miles of walking and hiking trails and opportunities for solitude, inspiration, physical challenge, renewal, and back country camping. A back country camping permit is required year-round for all overnight trips into the Charon’s Garden Wilderness Area. Permits are not required for day hiking. Permits are issued for three-day periods: Friday-Saturday-Sunday or Monday-Tuesday-Wednesday. No permits are issued for Thursday. No more than 10 people will be issued permits over any three-day period. To reach the designated back country camping area a 1.5 mile hike is required. The trail is not marked and is considered a moderate to strenuous hike. The back country camping trail head begins at the Sunset Picnic Area. Back country campers are required to park vehicles at the Sunset Picnic Area and display permit on their dashboard.
description.discounts: There are no discounts for annual passes, military, seniors, or children. All people count for wilderness quotas and fees.
description.driving_directions: From I-44 take Highway 49 (exit 45). Go west 7 miles to the Refuge gate or 14 miles to the Visitor Center. If coming from Highway 62, take Highway 115 (Cache exit) north to the Refuge Gate.
description.fee_policy:
Reservation Fee: $16 reservation fee ($10 Charon’s Garden fee + $6 recreation.gov reservation fee)

Recreation Fee: $5.00 per person user fee
description.need_to_know_email:
The signed permit must be in the group leader’s possession during the trip and must be presented to refuge officials upon request. The group leader signing the permit is accepting responsibility to ensure everyone in their group will follow the rules and regulations on the permit.

Human Waste Disposal

There are no restrooms in the wilderness. Visitors to the Charon's Garden Wilderness area are expected to pack-out their solid human waste. In other areas poop should be buried six to eight inches deep and at least 100 feet or more from water sources, trails, or campsites.

Behave Responsibly

Respect other visitor’s desire for quiet and solitude. Please help protect this natural resource and leave it unmarked for future visitors. Familiarize yourself with the seven principles of Leave No Trace and review wilderness rules with all members of your group.

  • Pack out all your trash, help keep our wilderness areas pristine.
  • Protect water quality, don’t use soap in natural waterways, even biodegradable soap can damage aquatic life. Waste water should be scattered at least 100 feet away from any water source.
  • Don’t cut switchbacks, shortcutting damages the trail and adds to erosion.
  • No drones, they are prohibited in wilderness.
  • No loud audio devices, let the sounds of nature be part of the wilderness experience.
  • Campfires are restricted, wood growth is very slow and what wood exists helps sustain the natural soil, plant and animal community.

Safety Is Your Responsibility!

  • Come prepared to find your way. Do not rely on cell phone for communication or navigation, most of the forest has no cell service.
  • Check weather and trail conditions.
  • Download maps, and emergency information before starting on the trail.
  • Plan to be self-sufficient, bring adequate supplies of food, water and clothing.

description.need_to_know_permit:
When applying for or reserving a backcountry camping date in the Charon's Garden Wilderness Area, I certify that:

  • I recognize that this date is not transferable upon securing this reservation and that I will become the responsible person for this permit;
  • I am/will be at least 18 years old before the permit date;
  • I recognize that this reservation / application is for a private (non-commercial) backcountry camping permit. 

The safety of visitors and protection of this wonderful, natural resource, are always our top priorities. As such, securing your permit also comes with agreement from you and your guests to the following:

  • Observe all local, state and Federal laws and regulations.
  • Camp in the designated camp area listed on the permit.
  • Carry and display permit upon request of any Refuge Officer.
  • Public Notice: Boil order for all areas west of Doris Campground.
  • Know before you go...familiarize yourself with Wichita Mountain's rules and regulations.
  • No cell phone coverage in Charon's Garden Wilderness Area.
  • In case of emergency, call 911.
  • Frequent weather changes occur.
  • Be prepared for severe heat, wind, rain, and possible tornadoes.
  • For your safety, bison and longhorn are free roaming. Do not approach.
  • Bring water with you. Do not rely on streams or ponds in the area.
  • Fires are not allowed in the Charon's Garden Wilderness backcountry campground. 
  • Parking for Charon's Garden backcountry camping is only authorized at the Sunset Parking Area.
description.quota_details: The quota for this permit is measured in number of people per permit period. The maximum # of people allowed during a permit period is 10 persons. The maximum # of people on a permit, is 5 per permit.
description.season_information:
A back country camping permit is required year-round for all overnight trips into the Charon’s Garden Wilderness Area. Permit allows permit holder and the specified number in the group to hike in to the designated camping area and stay overnight. Permits are issued for three-day periods: Friday-Saturday-Sunday or Monday-Tuesday-Wednesday. No permits are issued for Thursday. No more than 10 people will be issued permits over any three-day period.

Permits can be reserved up to three months in advance.

important_dates.description: Permits are required year-round; reservations available up to three months in advance.
